title: Big and not flexible for 90 deg bend in neck
text: Big and not flexible for 90 deg bend in neck. I was a little surprised that the handle is the full sized that you see in regular spatulas.  It irked great at scooping at the bottom of jars and then ones in particular.  Where it didn’t worked for necks that have a 90 degree bend.  Game over.  Just a tad disappointed that it was a little too big for the general purpose, although I can see you will have a Very good grip.

description: This versatile jar spatula from KitchenAid is perfect for scraping batter from bowls or sauces from pans. It’s also great also for spreading icing on cakes and pastries, or jellies and jams on bread. The spatula features a narrow head and long handle to maximize reach into even the deepest jars to easily scrape the sides and bottoms of all containers. The long, sturdy handle is ergonomically designed for optimal comfort and control. This durable spatula features a silicone head that’s heat-resistant to 500 degrees F, so it can also be used for stirring and folding in ingredients while cooking. Measures 11.3 inches by 1.2 inches. Dishwasher safe.
